items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I mean Bobby Pratt, the wonderful trombone player and piano player, he played the hell out of it with Roy Eldridge

ctx.x: At Jimmy Ryan’s. I mean Bobby Pratt, the wonderful trombone player and piano player, he played the hell out of it with Roy Eldridge you know like that, he knew the sucker.
Right. So you did “All the Things You Are.” It does have that, getting about halfway through it’s got that —
